title: Use of Radiofrequency Ablation to Eliminate Continuous Atrial Fibrillation in Patients Undergoing Mitral Valve Surgery
brief_summary: The aim of this prospective randomized clinical trial was to evaluate the early and late outcome following left atrial radiofrequency ablation during MV surgery for the treatment of continuous atrial fibrillation and to assess the functional effects of restoration of sinus rhythm.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patients requiring MV surgery with at least 6 month history of atrial fibrillation

Exclusion Criteria:

* Patients with sick sinus syndrome
* Hyperthyroidism
* Permanent pacemaker
* Previous cardiac surgery
